title: sync: seed listings 15 Nov (path releases Uptime v0.5.13, Oncall v0.5.16)
head: cloud/je-sync-39
body:
Advance Uptime v0.5.12 → v0.5.13 and Oncall v0.5.15 → v0.5.16 after checking fresh non-draft, non-prerelease GitHub Releases with rer-release.dsse.json assets. Refresh tagged copy provenance and generated listings; keep published wording and release statuses.

The full 49-seed dry sync proposed these two versions plus HappyToHelp v0.4.30. HappyToHelp stays at v0.4.28 because v0.4.30 is only a tag, with no published release. Marks, colours, homepages, pricing and excluded slugs have no changes. Counts remain 49 listings: 35 released and 14 coming soon. Existing copy/evidence follow-ups remain with the lane.

Validation: npm ci; copy-only and mechanical sync; final scoped dry sync (only the explained HappyToHelp tag remains); npm run listings; npm run listings -- --check; npm run type-check; npm run lint; npm run build; diff scope/hygiene and all-candidate identity/trailer audit. The lane retains the independent gate, Mac publication scan, landing and deployment.
